note: macOS 26 (Tahoe). Validated against build 25F80 across two DDM-active devices. mdm_command returns live mdmclient/ManagedClient events. DDM declarative subsystems are now PINNED (see ddm entry). Command status/type ride in a check-in bracket '[Status(CommandType):n]' (e.g. [Acknowledged(InstallProfile):0]) rather than CommandUUID=/RequestType=/Status= — normalize.py is tuned for this. No command UUID is exposed even with the private-data logging profile on, so correlation on macOS 26 is time+type, not UUID.

enrollment.predicate: subsystem CONTAINS "com.apple.ManagedClient.cloudconfigurationd" OR process == "cloudconfigurationd" OR (processImagePath CONTAINS "mdmclient" AND (eventMessage CONTAINS "MDM_Authenticate" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "MDM_TokenUpdate" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "MDM_CheckOut" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "MDM_SCEP_Enroll" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "Enrolling MDM" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "Unenrolling" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "DeviceEnrollment"))
enrollment.note: cloudconfigurationd covers DEP/ADE only. A MANUAL profile enrollment never touches it, so this category returned 0 events for a real failed manual enrollment while the failure (HTTP 401 on MDM_Authenticate, after SCEP succeeded) sat in mdmclient's own check-in lines. Those are now in scope. Keep in sync with the enrollment step in tools/collect-mdm-logs.sh.

asset_download.predicate: process == "storedownloadd" OR process == "appstored" OR subsystem == "com.apple.appstored" OR subsystem == "com.apple.AppStoreDaemon"
asset_download.note: A device-assigned VPP/App Store install on macOS 26/27 is carried by appstored (subsystem com.apple.appstored), not storedownloadd: a real 27.0 (26A5416b) managed-install capture logged 0 storedownloadd events while appstored did all the download and hand-off work. storedownloadd is kept for the older/manifest-URL path.

ddm.predicate: subsystem CONTAINS "com.apple.dmd" OR subsystem CONTAINS "remotemanagementd" OR subsystem CONTAINS "ManagedAppDistribution" OR subsystem CONTAINS "SoftwareUpdateMacController" OR processImagePath CONTAINS "mdmclient"
ddm.note: Declarative subsystems pinned empirically on 25F80 across two DDM-active devices: com.apple.dmd (declarative mgmt daemon), com.apple.remotemanagementd, com.apple.ManagedAppDistribution, com.apple.SoftwareUpdateMacController. mdmclient retained for the DeclarativeManagement command round-trip; de-dupe by raw_ref against mdm_command.

declaration.predicate: process == "remotemanagementd" OR subsystem CONTAINS "remotemanagementd" OR subsystem CONTAINS "com.apple.dmd" OR subsystem CONTAINS "SoftwareUpdateMacController" OR subsystem CONTAINS "ManagedAppDistribution"
declaration.note: DDM declaration state for get_ddm_status — declarative subsystems only (no mdmclient, unlike the ddm category). remotemanagementd is the status/activation engine on 25F80.

pkg_install.predicate: process == "installd" OR process == "installer" OR process == "system_installd" OR subsystem == "com.apple.install"
pkg_install.note: Added system_installd: observed handling PackageKit installs alongside installd on 25F80.
